description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'AbstractSnapshotTuner' that provides methods for modifying and managing Liquibase changelog XML files within the OpenMRS project. It includes functionalities for adding license headers, reading and writing changelog files, and updating change logs, indicating its role in database schema version control.

classes.name: AbstractSnapshotTuner
classes.description: An abstract class providing core methods for managing Liquibase changelog files, including license header management, file reading/writing, and changelog updating.

methods.name: updateChangeLog
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for applying specific updates to a changelog Document.

methods.name: addLicenseHeaderToFileIfNeeded
methods.description: Adds the OpenMRS license header to the specified file if it does not already contain it.

methods.name: createUpdatedChangeLogFile
methods.description: Reads a source changelog file, applies updates via updateChangeLog(), and writes the result to a target file.

methods.name: getNamespaceUris
methods.description: Returns the map of namespace URIs used within the class.

methods.name: addLicenseHeaderToFileContent
methods.description: Reads the content of a file, prepends the license header, and returns the modified content.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes the specified file if it exists.

methods.name: isLicenseHeaderInFile
methods.description: Checks if the license header snippet is already present in the specified file.

methods.name: readChangeLogFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a changelog XML file from disk into a Document object.

methods.name: readChangeLogResource
methods.description: Reads and parses a changelog XML resource into a Document object.

methods.name: readInputStream
methods.description: Reads all data from an InputStream into a String.

methods.name: getResourceAsStream
methods.description: Gets an InputStream for a resource file within the classpath.

methods.name: readResource
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a resource file into a String.

methods.name: writeChangeLogFile
methods.description: Writes a Document object to disk as a pretty-printed XML file.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Writes string content to a specified file.
